name: Central Mississippi Area Agency on Aging
organization: Central Mississippi Area Agency on Aging
description: The Area Agency on Aging for this county: information and assistance, home-delivered and congregate meals, in-home services, transportation, caregiver support and senior legal assistance.
next_step: Call and describe what is hard right now. Ask for information and assistance. The Mississippi Access to Care line, 844-822-4622, also connects you to aging and disability help. Military service is not required.
constraints: Many services focus on people age 60 and older and adults with disabilities; eligibility and waitlists vary by program.

source_evidence.title: Mississippi Department of Human Services: State Plan on Aging, FFY 2023 update (approved September 27, 2022)
source_evidence.scope: Contact page listing the ten Area Agencies on Aging, their phones and the counties each serves, with the statewide Adult Protective Services and MAC/SHIP lines; read in full. Central Mississippi’s seven counties are confirmed by its fiscal year 2027 request for proposals: https://cmpdd.org/?p=2177

name: Mississippi Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.
Mississippi’s ten local ombudsman programs are housed in the Planning and Development Districts with the Area Agencies on Aging; the help line connects you with yours.

source_evidence.title: Mississippi Department of Human Services: Long-Term Care Ombudsman
source_evidence.scope: Statewide Long-Term Care Ombudsman help line, 1-888-844-0041, and the facility types served; read in full. The page was last modified April 8, 2026.

source_evidence.title: Mississippi Administrative Code, Title 18, Part 26: Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
